gates.name: basis_coefficient_convention
gates.limitation: Constant basis normalization can be absorbed into a freely fitted coefficient; physical fractions and published coefficient transfer remain unverified

gates.name: matching_exclusive_measurements
gates.required: Original exclusive event list or numerical bin counts with exact bin edges, cuts, energy/frame and campaign identity. Figure pixels alone are not raw counts.

gates.name: detector_acceptance_and_calibration
gates.required: Matched response and independent calibration with uncertainty, angular dependence and any parent alignment treatment

gates.name: parameter_uncertainty
gates.required: Joint parameter refit or justified likelihood with correlated nuisance parameters; diagonal errors alone insufficient

gates.name: model_discrepancy
gates.required: Final state interactions and published residual disagreement retained; no success gate based only on matrix rank

gates.name: validation_holdouts
gates.required: Independent campaigns, target batches or calibration cycles; source-derived reanalyses not independent

gates.name: transport_to_apparatus
gates.required: Material/state-specific data, actual source fluence/target and detector specifications

release_effect: New version only. Earlier modules and failed results remain preserved.
